abduction-0.title: Betty and Barney Hill abduction
abduction-0.place: US Route 3 south of Lancaster, White Mountains, New Hampshire, USA
abduction-0.summary: Driving home at night, the Hills said a light followed their car through the White Mountains and they arrived home about two hours later than expected. Under hypnosis in 1964 both described being taken aboard a craft and examined. It was the first abduction claim to get wide publicity; skeptics point to the hypnosis and to vivid dreams Betty had soon after the sighting.
evidence: Sighting reported to Pease Air Force Base; noted in Project Blue Book.
Betty kept the dress she wore that night; stains on it were later tested.

Details of the account echo Betty’s nightmares after the sighting, recorded before hypnosis.
